# Asia Open: Supply Tight, Prices Rising Across Core Segments  
**Bottom line:** Market scores stay elevated (supply 71, price 84.7); lock in pricing where advised and push lead‑time reductions on high‑risk memory parts.

## What changed
- Overall market supply risk holds at 71.0 (no change) and price trend at 84.7, both labeled **Elevated/Rising** with high confidence 84.2 %【source】.  
- Drivers confirming pressure: Semiconductor PPI up 9.1 % annualized (3‑mo) and global chip sales +146.1 % YoY in Aug 2026, both pushing tighter supply and higher prices[1][2].  
- Regional signals: TSMC revenue +50.9 % YoY (3‑mo) and Korea exports +171 % YoY (first 10 days Oct 2026) add to the supply squeeze[3][4].  
- No score movement this week; the market remains in a “Rising‑Supply‑Risk, Rising‑Price‑Trend” regime.

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**; channel stock **27,211** units (≈ 17.7 weeks of supply).  
- No on‑order quantity (PBO) disclosed; next arrival not scheduled.  
- Price **$5.56** / unit (qty 1) vs **$2.51** / unit (qty 1k).  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 65 % chance prices rise in 3 months, but supply is adequate; fix price now, keep normal ordering cadence【source】.


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – supply 70.3 (Elevated), price 78.8 (Rising), confidence High.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – supply 73.1 (Elevated), price 84.8 (Rising), confidence High.  
- Analog & power management – supply 66.8 (Rising), price 83.5 (Rising), confidence High.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – supply 69.7 (Rising), price 83.5 (Rising), confidence High.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – supply 64.8 (Rising), price 82.4 (Rising), confidence Medium.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** – supply risk 83.3 (Elevated); driver: 52‑week factory lead time vs 12‑week norm.  
- **MT40A1G16TB-062E:F** – supply risk 83.3 (Elevated); same 52‑week lead‑time driver.  
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – supply risk 83.2 (Elevated); 52‑week lead‑time driver.  
- **IS25LP128-JBLE** – supply risk 83.2 (Elevated); 52‑week lead‑time driver.  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – supply risk 83.2 (Elevated); 52‑week lead‑time driver.

## Outlook
- **Chip prices, next 3 mo:** 66 % probability of rise; expected +2.17 % (80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); forecast based on a **tested model edge**.  
- **Chip prices, next 6 mo:** 52 % probability of rise; expected +4.34 % (‑8.79 % to +17.46 %); **trend‑following baseline**.  
- **Fab utilization, next 3 mo:** 63 % chance supply tightens; expected +1.82 pts (‑1.71 to +5.36 pts); baseline.  
- **Fab utilization, next 6 mo:** 60 % chance supply tightens; expected +3.64 pts (‑2.16 to +9.45 pts); baseline.  
- Buy‑timing calls: lock pricing for listed parts (including IPB017N10N5ATMA1) and buy ahead for high‑risk memory items.

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock pricing now** on parts flagged “Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)”, especially the Infineon MOSFET, to avoid the 65 % upside price risk while lead times remain manageable.  
2. **Demand accelerated shipments** or consignment stock for the top‑risk memory components (MT25QL128…, MT40A1G16…) citing the 52‑week factory lead times; negotiate partial‑run releases or priority allocation.
